entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hello. Did you turn up any[n]useful information?
There are a lot of rumors...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Perhaps you're more suited to be[n]a detective than a phantom thief.
entries.uk: Мабуть, детектив із тебе кращий,[n]ніж Фантомний Злодій.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: All right. After this, I'll be[n]joining up with you.
entries.uk: Гаразд. Після цього я[n]приєднаюся до вас.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: There are some things I'd like to[n]discuss in person, so let me know[n]when you're going.
entries.uk: Дещо я хотів би обговорити[n]особисто, тож дай знати,[n]коли вирушатимеш.
